errors.text: The predicted sign is reversed: the target finds an approximately 12% increase in lattice thermal conductivity with SRO, whereas the generated hypothesis predicts a 10–25% decrease.

The dominant target mechanisms—reduced lattice distortion and formation of high-conductivity percolating HfTi/TiZr ordered pathways—are omitted and replaced by an unsupported DAPB phonon-scattering analogy.

The proposed measurements obtain total thermal conductivity from laser-flash diffusivity but do not separate the electronic contribution, so they cannot directly test the claimed change in lattice thermal conductivity.
The proposed L12/L11 ordering is poorly matched to the target single-phase bcc system, where B2-like ordering and cluster percolation are the relevant structural mediators.
